behind.Body: An older copy of the data was restored, or records were removed. Confirm that you keep it, or close the program and restore another copy.
behind.Consequence: The missing numbers are declared as lost and never given again: the next invoice takes the number after them.

altered.Title: A record was changed outside the program
altered.Body: An invoice, a receipt, a payment or a line of the log is not what the program wrote. Call support before going on if you do not know why.
altered.Consequence: Your answer is kept in the log with what the program found, and work goes on from the database as it is.

foreign.Title: This data comes from another installation
foreign.Body: The database on this PC is not the one the program was last used with here. Confirm if you moved the centre's data to this PC.
foreign.Consequence: From now on this PC follows this database.

unanchored.Title: The program was reinstalled on data it already had
unanchored.Body: The database holds invoices or log entries, and this PC has no memory of them. Confirm that this is the centre's data.
unanchored.Consequence: From now on this PC follows this database.

ahead.Title: The database must be checked
ahead.Body: The program could not confirm the last records.
ahead.Consequence: Your answer is kept in the log.

unchecked.Title: The database could not be checked
unchecked.Body: The program could not compare the data with what it last recorded on this PC. Nothing can be worked on until it can. Try again; if it happens again, close the program, open it again, and call support if it still fails.
unchecked.FailedAgain: It could not be checked this time either.

Jump.Consequence: Until you confirm, no invoice or receipt can be issued, and the day's own work (contracts ending, the daily copy) waits.

Behind.Body: The date of this PC is earlier than the last recorded work. Lock, correct the date and time of the PC, and sign in again. Nobody else can sign in meanwhile.
Behind.Consequence: Only if the recorded date was itself wrong: confirm today's date with your reason. The work is then measured from today. An invoice dated before the last one stays refused.
